menu.irisv.providers.title: IrisV Providers
menu.irisv.tooltip.debug_chat: Shows IrisV debug messages in chat.
menu.irisv.tooltip.theme: Changes the visual theme for IrisV menus and overlays.
menu.irisv.tooltip.providers: Opens detailed settings for providers, recipes, and HUD indicators.
menu.irisv.tooltip.overlay: Enables the world hover information overlay.
menu.irisv.tooltip.position: Moves the overlay position on screen.
menu.irisv.tooltip.advanced_tooltips: Adds more details to tooltips when available.
menu.irisv.tooltip.compact: Reduces the display so it takes less space.
menu.irisv.tooltip.side: Chooses which side HUD indicators use.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.drops: Shows information for items on the ground.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.inventories: Shows useful contents for compatible inventories.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.recipes: Enables the inventory catalog and recipe interactions.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.hud: Enables or hides IrisV HUD indicators.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.tool_durabi: Shows the durability state of the equipped tool.
menu.irisv.providers.tooltip.durability_: Adds the exact remaining durability count.
recip.irisv.wiki.title: IrisV Wiki
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.pages: Arrows or mouse wheel: change page in the list
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.categories: Category button: filters blocks, potions, food, tools...
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.favorites: Middle click an item: add or remove a favorite
recip.irisv.wiki.catalog.eye: Eye: hide or show the catalog from inventory
recip.irisv.wiki.shift_click: Shift + click: give one stack in creative
recip.irisv.wiki.middle_click: Middle click: add or remove a favorite
recip.irisv.wiki.scroll: Mouse wheel: change page or scroll favorites
recip.irisv.wiki.search_text: Type a name to filter items
recip.irisv.wiki.search_highlight: Double click: yellow mode, dims non-matches
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.overlay: Overlay: shows info without opening a menu
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.providers: Providers: toggle blocks, entities, drops, fluids and inventories separately
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.advanced: Advanced: adds useful details when available
recip.irisv.wiki.tooltips.position: Position: moves the overlay to a corner or top center
recip.irisv.wiki.hud.indicators: Indicators: small visual reminders outside inventory
recip.irisv.wiki.hud.durability: Durability: shows tool state and remaining count
recip.irisv.wiki.hud.side: Side: places indicators on the left or right
recip.irisv.wiki.recipe.survival: Survival: recipes are prepared but disabled for now
recip.irisv.wiki.recipe.creative: Creative: click gives 1 item, Shift gives a stack, full inventory drops it
recip.irisv.wiki.recipe.hidden: Full inventory: extra items drop on the ground
